conceptPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one finished high-end art-direction mockup for the Three Kingdoms game 逆转五丈原, chapter 夷陵. Input image is a LAYOUT REFERENCE ONLY: preserve the upper panoramic mountain river map, lower full-width horizontal chat area occupying half of the screen, and narrow right-hand military status panel. Output one full-screen 16:10 landscape game UI, straight-on orthographic screen capture, no surrounding room or physical desk perspective.
Redesign the material language decisively, with darker, weighty, tactile historical Chinese military campaign aesthetics. The current screenshot is much too bright and looks like an HTML form. Use ink-black weathered hardwood backing with visible fine worn grain, restrained dark patinated bronze corner fittings with engraved geometric Han-dynasty border details, deep charcoal-brown slightly fibrous paper/linen insets. Overall dark desaturated charcoal, smoked umber and muted bronze. NO broad cream/yellow/bright beige panels. Readable pale warm-gray Chinese brush/Kai-style text, muted gold names, restrained cinnabar accents only for selected tabs and send seal. Real dimensional construction: recessed central writing surface, thick layered frame lip, realistic tight contact shadows, top-left grazing light revealing scratched bronze and paper fibers. Sophisticated cinematic game UI craft, restrained historically inspired, no fantasy dragons, no ornate gold excess, no orange global tint.
Lower central chat layout: top small object tabs 沙摩柯, 冯习·张南, 傅肜, 传令. Under tabs two subtle filters 沙摩柯往来 and 所有传令. Incoming message rests on the dark fibrous reading surface at left; own message is a small overlapping dark leather-paper slip at right, not a rounded modern chat bubble. Show two short readable lines e.g. '西沟还有伤兵，不能丢下。' and '伤兵还能自行撤退吗？'. At bottom, low-profile long recessed writing slip with placeholder 问沙摩柯…… and a small dark cinnabar rectangular seal-like 传话 action on the right, not a glossy website button.
The narrow right panel keeps exactly its approved vertical layout but looks like a separate heavy military tally ledger with dark timber frame, bronze corner clamps, and dark paper interior: header 军情, total 接应兵力 2500人, four compact rows 甲队700人 / 乙队800人 / 丙队600人 / 丁队400人 and 营中待命. Small vertical wooden tally tokens instead of HTML square badges; shallow physically incised dividers not form rows. Bottom integrated timer '传令间隔 00:09', tiny secondary text. Layout must remain functional and legible, no unusable tiny ornate text. Map labels and original flag markers remain approximately in the same positions. No change to gameplay, no new fictional stats, no portraits, no big title banners. This is a credible production game UI art mockup, not a wireframe or website screenshot.
materialPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup asset production. Reference image is the APPROVED-FOR-IMPLEMENTATION STYLE REFERENCE only (not a user approval): reproduce the tactile material look of its dark Three Kingdoms military ledger game interface. Generate ONE square 2x2 material texture atlas for real runtime UI. Each quadrant fills exactly one quarter of the square, with a hard straight division exactly at 50% width and 50% height, no gutters or frames, no labels or symbols. Orthographic, perfectly flat texture samples, not a physical scene.
TOP LEFT quadrant: charcoal-black aged hardwood, very dark desaturated brown-black timber, subtle fine long horizontal worn grain, a few tiny scratches, restrained top-left raking light, no distinct boards or seams. Average color around #211c16.
TOP RIGHT quadrant: dark smoked-umber handmade paper/linen surface as the central reading surface in reference, fine visible fibers, understated shallow mottling, very readable low-contrast microtexture, matte, no bright folds or spots, average #352d24. Must look like fibrous dark antique paper, not stone, not smooth flat color.
BOTTOM LEFT quadrant: slightly lighter warm gray-brown aged thick writing paper for writing slip and message slips, irregular natural fine fibers and tiny worn creases, average #514638, neutral smoked brown, not cream, not yellow, not leather reptile skin.
BOTTOM RIGHT quadrant: deep dark cinnabar lacquer on wood, scuffed muted red/brown, faint carved texture and small scratches, subdued edge-free illumination, average #5b261b, never bright red.
All texture samples must be full-bleed, evenly detailed all the way to quadrant boundaries, designed for UI backgrounds that can be stretched. No bevels, no cast shadow, no bevelled panel borders, no text whatsoever, no writing, no Chinese characters, no logos, no icons, no props, no gold ornament. Avoid global amber/yellow. High fidelity subtle material detail, fine grain not large distracting scratches.
